source_policy: Only authoritative public sources (PubMed indexed records).

departments.case_title: Pediatric acute appendicitis with appendicolith and appendiceal perforation: a delayed diagnosis and treatment due to atypical symptoms, resulting in prolonged hospitalization
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 该病例提示阑尾炎可出现非典型表现，延误会导致穿孔并延长住院。RAG问答应优先识别“迁移性腹痛+发热/呕吐+病程进展”并快速分流急诊外科。

departments.case_title: A Case Report of Diabetic Ketoacidosis and Acute Ischemic Stroke in a Young Woman
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 年轻患者可同时出现DKA与急性缺血性卒中，说明代谢危机与神经急症可叠加。系统需在“高血糖+意识/神经体征变化”场景中优先触发急诊评估。

departments.case_title: Atypical etiology of severe bilateral pneumonia in infant: A case report
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 婴幼儿重症肺炎可由非典型病原引起，早期表现可能不典型。知识库应强调呼吸窘迫、喂养差、低氧等危险信号和住院阈值。

departments.case_title: A delayed diagnosis of asymptomatic ectopic pregnancy after prolonged use of oral contraceptive: a case report and literature review
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 异位妊娠可能在症状不典型时被延迟诊断。RAG应优先识别“停经/异常出血/腹痛”并提示先做hCG与经阴超，而非仅做普通止痛建议。

departments.case_title: Acute ischemic stroke following a camel bite: a case report and literature review
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 卒中可在非常规诱因后出现，核心仍是时间窗与神经定位体征。系统应强化“突然偏瘫/失语/视野异常”的急诊卒中通道提示。

departments.case_title: Cauda equina syndrome with unilateral symptoms: A case report and review of the literature
departments.journal: International Journal of Surgery Case Reports
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 马尾综合征并不总是双侧典型表现，单侧症状也可能延误诊断。问答系统应优先询问大小便功能、会阴区感觉和进行性无力。

departments.case_title: Paradoxical pyoderma gangrenosum in severe atopic dermatitis after Janus kinase inhibitor administration: A case report
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 重度特应性皮炎在JAK抑制剂治疗下可出现反常严重皮损。知识库需补充“治疗中病情反向恶化”及药物相关不良反应分流。

departments.case_title: Acute angle-closure glaucoma after botulinum toxin injection for blepharospasm treatment: A case report
departments.journal: American Journal of Ophthalmology Case Reports
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 急性闭角可在诱因后短时间发生，延误将导致不可逆视损。RAG应识别“眼痛+恶心呕吐+彩虹视+视力下降”的急症组合。

departments.case_title: Long-lasting spontaneous ecchymoses after suggesting indication of warfarin treatment due to drug interaction among clopidogrel and rosuvastatin
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 抗凝与他药联用可显著增加出血风险。系统应在“瘀斑/黑便/血尿+华法林或联合抗血小板”场景中优先触发药学安全告警。

departments.case_title: Cefoperazone/sulbactam-induced refractory Kounis syndrome in anaphylactic shock: a case report
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 过敏性休克可与冠脉痉挛/缺血并存（Kounis综合征），属于高危急诊场景。问答应强调肾上腺素优先、持续监护与心电评估。

departments.case_title: Case Report: Fever of unknown origin and newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation in a healthy man due to Q fever
departments.clinical_summary_zh: 不明原因发热可伴发心律失常并指向少见感染病因。系统应支持“FUO分层+暴露史+心电异常并发症”联合检索。
